newsitem.title: UK: Ushers of Trowbridge gains 12 pct on debut.
newsitem.headline: Ushers of Trowbridge gains 12 pct on debut.

text.p: Shares in Ushers of Trowbridge Group Plc, a regional brewer, jumped over 12 percent following the company's debut on the London Stock Exchange on Monday.
The initial public offering was almost three times oversubscribed at the offer price of 110p, and mostly placed with UK institutions, said David Charles of lead underwriter Hambros Bank.
By 1040 GMT the shares were up 13.5p to 123-1/2p.
The company received net proceeds of 38.3 million stg, for a total market value of 108.7 million stg, Charles said.
The company intends to use the proceeds to reduce borrowing and fund expansion.
Ushers of Trowbridge had operating profit of 16.9 million stg on turnover of 65.4 million stg in 1996. The company has 541 tied pubs in England and Wales.
